methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked. Any method is processed identically. A GET has no body, so req.json() throws a SyntaxError -> 500 {"error":"Internal error"} (after auth).

auth.notes: First statement; 401 precedes any body validation. See _common.json for exact 401/500 bodies.

request.contentType: application/json (not checked; body is parsed with req.json() regardless of the header)
request.parse: `const { layoutImageB64, ...inputs } = await req.json()` with no .catch: malformed or empty body -> 500 {"error":"Internal error"}. A JSON `null` body makes the destructuring throw TypeError -> 500 {"error":"Internal error"}. A JSON array/primitive yields inputs without `topic` -> 400 'Topic is required'.

fields.name: topic
fields.validation: `if (!inputs?.topic)`: falsy ('' , 0, false, null, missing) -> 400. Any truthy value passes, including non-strings.

fields.name: numSlides
fields.bounds: only a lower bound: `inputs.numSlides < 1` -> 400. NO upper bound (MAX_SLIDES_PER_DECK is not applied here). Missing/undefined or a non-numeric string passes because `undefined < 1` and `'abc' < 1` are false; '0' (string) is rejected because '0' < 1 is true.

fields.name: company, audience, style, keyMessages, context, brandId, primaryColor, accentColor, fontStyle, styleInstructions, language
fields.validation: None in this handler. Typed as WizardInputs only (TypeScript cast, no runtime check).

fields.name: layoutImageB64
fields.bounds: decoded length 1..4194304 bytes (4 MB); first 4 bytes must be 89 50 4E 47
fields.validation: If present (!== undefined): non-string or empty string -> 400 'layoutImageB64 must be a base64 string'; decoded length 0 or > 4MB -> 400 'Layout image must be a PNG up to 4MB'; wrong magic -> 400 'Layout image must be a PNG'. JSON null counts as present and non-string -> 400. Decoding uses Buffer.from(s,'base64'), which silently skips invalid characters.

request.unknownFields: Forwarded verbatim. Everything except layoutImageB64 is passed as `inputs` to the background trigger and on to generateStoryline/prompt assembly. layoutImageB64 is stripped from inputs.

checkOrder: 6. jobId = randomUUID(); write layout blob (if any), then the pending job record, then trigger background (quick-generate.ts:36-40)

body.error: layoutImageB64 must be a base64 string

errors.when: layoutImageB64 present but not a non-empty string

body.error: Layout image must be a PNG up to 4MB
Layout image must be a PNG

errors.when: first 4 decoded bytes are not the PNG magic
malformed/empty JSON body, JSON null body, or a Blobs write failure

sideEffects: If layoutImageB64 valid: writes the PNG to deck-images store at quick/<jobId>/layout.png (quick-generate.ts:37, blobs.ts:194-196). The background deletes it after use (quick-generate-background.ts:119-123).
Writes quick-jobs blob quick/<jobId>.json = {status:'pending', userId} (quick-generate.ts:38, blobs.ts:198-200).
POSTs {jobId, userId, inputs, layoutImage:boolean} to <origin>/.netlify/functions/quick-generate-background (quick-generate.ts:39-40, trigger.ts:51-57).
No DB writes: no deck row, no deck cap reservation, no usage_events (openapi.yaml:403-405 says so too).
externalCalls: None in the foreground. The background run calls Anthropic (generateStoryline, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) and OpenAI image generation/edit (OPENAI_API_KEY), up to 10 concurrent images (quick-generate-background.ts:22, 36-37, 41, 94-110).
quirks: Trigger failures are swallowed: triggerWithRetry retries twice (200ms, 600ms) then only logs, so the route still returns 202 and the job stays {status:'pending'} forever (trigger.ts:1-25, quick-generate.ts:40-41).
No upper bound on numSlides and no deck cap: the client controls how many slides (and so how many paid images) are generated.

The background does NOT call reserveImageSlot, so quick-generate images bypass GLOBAL_IMAGES_PER_DAY (quick-generate-background.ts has no reserveImageSlot import; compare generate-background / brand-preview-background).
storyline divider insertion (insertDividers) runs in the background, so the number of images can exceed numSlides (quick-generate-background.ts:41).
The 202 body carries only jobId (no warnings); warnings appear later on /api/quick-status.
beforeAnyState: Stateless submit: no prior state required. A brandId that the caller cannot read silently falls back to the legacy profile kit/defaults in the background (db.ts:322-328), it is not rejected here.

tests.asserts: 202 + string jobId + pending job write + trigger payload {jobId,userId,inputs}; 400 on empty topic; 400 on numSlides 0; 401 passthrough; inline layout: no field -> layoutImage false and no blob write; valid PNG -> blob at quick/<jobId>/layout.png and layoutImage true and inputs.layoutImageB64 stripped; non-PNG -> 400; >4MB -> 400; non-string -> 400. Status codes only, no error strings asserted.

callers.who: none in Slide-Creator src/ or Auxi_Connector
callers.where: grep of src/ and C:\Github\Auxi_Connector\app for '/api/quick-' finds nothing
callers.expects: External/programmatic API users only (documented as the 'Quick start' path in openapi.yaml:23-28 and postman '1 · Quick Generate').

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:396-468. Matches the 202 {jobId} and layoutImageB64 description. Discrepancies: does not document the 500 on malformed JSON; 401 has no body schema; WizardInputs schema may mark fields required that the handler does not check (only topic and numSlides>=1 are checked).
docs.postman: docs/postman_collection.json '1.1 Start quick generate': valid example body. The collection-level auth uses a hard-coded dev bypass key in the `dev_key` variable (a committed secret; see INDEX.md).
